title: House Always Wins

panels.shot: The roulette wheel slows. Brask lies across the numbers, monocle cracked, white tuxedo red. The ball drops into the green zero.

lines.speaker: Brask
lines.text: The order came from the Board... from the Basses. The hard money goes through Kalt's aquarium.

panels.shot: Brask's office. On the wall, an old photo: six men in tuxedos, a young Elias among them. One face, the man in the middle, is cut out with a razor. A Bell & Sons clock on the desk shows 3:17.

lines.text: My old life in one picture. Someone had cut out the man in the middle.

panels.shot: Exterior, rain. Mags's old green coupé waits at the curb. Mags (red hair, leather jacket) leans out of the window. Nero is in the back seat.

lines.speaker: Mags
lines.text: Get in. The aquarium's closed. That's when it opens for them.

panels.shot: Wide. The casino portico behind the car. A payphone on the wall rings and rings. Elias gets in without looking at it.
